messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: latency.gateway.p99 > 2.0s in eu-west-1 (alert id: A-8392)

pagerduty: Incident triggered: A-8392 — latency.gateway.p99 high (auto-page). Escalation: sre-jane -> platform-matt -> infra-bob

sre-jane: acked the page :thumbsup:

platform-matt: I'm on it, checking routing and autoscaler metrics now

infra-bob: seeing a spike in request fanout, multiple backends reported increased queue time. kvcache eviction rate jumped.

carol-ops: customer-impact: a few 5xxs, but mostly soft failures/timeouts — some slow responses to embeddings calls. Working on comms if degraded persists.

sre-jane: quick triage: p95 has small bump but p99 is the tail. Could be hot keys or noisy batch size. Any recent rollout?

platform-matt: no infra deploys in last 30m. There was a model flavor rollout earlier but it finished an hour ago. Checking autoscaler logs:

```kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME          REFERENCE          TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
serving-prod  Deployment/serving  85%/80%    3         20        18
```

platform-matt: autoscaler is maxing, replicas at 18/20, CPU near 90% on a subset of nodes.

infra-bob: checking GPU pool: some dedicated nodes show high mem pressure, OOM counts low but swap activity high. Could be KV cache thrash on a handful of shards.

sre-jane: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-tail|latency-tail runbook> — follow hot-key & kvcache section. I'm going to trigger a KV cache warmup script for top prefixes and scale out the sidecar pool.

sre-jane: running warmup: `scripts/kvcache/warmup.sh --prefixes=top100 --region=eu-west-1`

incident-bot: Command posted by sre-jane: scripts/kvcache/warmup.sh started (job id: warm-1759901234-1)

platform-matt: adding temporary extra serving nodes: `infra scale serving-prod --add 4 --reason "p99 surge eu-west-1"`

pagerduty: Event: manual mitigation started by platform-matt — scaling action requested.

carol-ops: Posted a brief customer notice to status: "Investigating latency increase in EU-West affecting some inference requests. Engineers are on it."

infra-bob: kvcache warmup job shows progress, eviction rate dropping from 1200/s -> 450/s, start seeing decreased miss amplification.

sre-jane: good. Also patching a rollback fallback: pin routing to stable model variant for eu-west traffic to reduce heterogeneity.

platform-matt: routing reconfiguration applied: map eu-west -> stable-2026-01 (gradual) — verifying traffic shift

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: duplicate pages suppressed for alert A-8392 (3 duplicates within 2m).

sre-jane: important note: duplicates were caused by two overlapping alert rules firing (p99 latency and queue-length). I'll file a follow-up to dedupe rules.

carol-ops: metrics now: p99 approaching baseline but still noisy: 1.8s -> 1.2s -> 0.9s over 12m. Customer impact decreasing.

platform-matt: added ephemeral nodes successfully, cluster CPU now 65% and request queue length dropped ~40%.

infra-bob: no more OOMs, swap activity normalized. kvcache eviction steady.

sre-jane: acking for rotation handoff in 10. Leaving monitoring. If p99 stays <1.2s for 15m, we'll resolve.

carol-ops: continuing status updates. No major customer escalations so far, support thread flagged for watch.

pagerduty: A-8392 acknowledged by sre-jane, assigned to platform-matt for follow-through.

platform-matt: follow-up actions: 1) dedupe overlapping alerts, 2) add autoscaler headroom for eu-west, 3) investigate KV shard balance; created ticket INF-4621.

sre-jane: agreed. Closing notes: mitigation effective, will hand back to oncall rotation.

incident-bot: Incident A-8392 marked as mitigated (p99 returned to baseline). Auto-close timer started (30m)

platform-matt: resolving the page now, will post postmortem draft in #incidents within 24h.

carol-ops: thanks all — nice quick ops teamwork :tada:

sre-jane: handing off to next oncall. Leaving breadcrumbs in ticket INF-4621.

pagerduty: Incident A-8392 resolved by platform-matt, incident closed.

incident-bot: Thread archived by incident-bot.
